title: Non-anchor absolute-position period prediction
rationale: This lane predeclares an absolute-position period rule before any new evidence is scored. It is not another public-anchor mining pass because discovery does not use public known-plaintext anchors, additive fragment values, candidate key material, routed-key results, held-out anchor controls, source-expanded candidate screens, or prior public-fragment structure screens.
prediction_target: Future independently documented non-anchor K4 position observations should be enriched in one or more predeclared one-based absolute-position residue classes from the registered period family at a rate exceeding seeded null, best-of-period, and multiple-comparison controls.
discovery_inputs: Predeclared period-family structural rule over one-based K4 absolute positions
K4 ciphertext length and registered non-anchor position universe
No candidate words, no key-material offsets, no routed additive fragments, no fragment values, and no source observation positions
evaluation_inputs: Future source-reviewed non-anchor K4 position observations selected before scoring
Observation files with per-position source notes and validation against the registered non-anchor universe
Independent target positions that are not public known-plaintext anchor fragments and are not derived from anchor additive-key values
controls: seeded same-size non-anchor position shuffle baseline
best-of-period null control across the registered period family
multiple-comparison correction across evaluated residue classes and sibling lanes
promotion blocked unless future independent observations beat all predeclared controls without post-hoc retuning
